Source: WI - Talend Installation Process (edited by Gustavo Piza). Fetched: 2026-06-01.

TOOL: Talend Studio (ETL/EDI platform used at OMDS for data transformation, extraction and pipeline execution)
CLOUD PORTAL: https://app.eu.cloud.talend.com/portal/
GITHUB REPOSITORY: https://github.com/OMDS-BIDevOps/OMDG_BIBU (ETL and EDI pipeline)
REPO STRUCTURE:
- process/INTEGRATIONS_HUB/ — Integration hub jobs (Hyperion, Magento, SFMC, Zendesk, GLPI, etc.)
- process/DATA_PIPELINES/ — Data pipeline jobs
- process/WORKFLOW_MANAGER/ — Workflow orchestration jobs
- joblets/ — Reusable Talend job components
- metadata/ — Connection and schema metadata
- context/ — Environment context files (dev/qa/prod)

JOB NAMING CONVENTION: [PREFIX]_[SOURCE]_[DESTINATION]_[DATAFLOW_ID]_[VERSION]
Example: SE_SAPERP_HYPERION_PLANNING_262_1.0 maps to GLPI Dataflow ID 262

INSTALLATION NOTES:
- Requires Java (Zulu JDK bundled with Talend Studio)
- JAVA_HOME environment variable must be set to Talend's Zulu bin folder
- Certificates must be imported into Talend's Java Truststore (cacerts): GitHub, Talend Cloud, Zscaler
- Certificate import command: keytool -importcert -alias [alias] -keystore [cacerts path] -file [cert.crt] -storepass changeit
- Users must be assigned the correct role in Talend Cloud and added to relevant projects by the admin
- Login via Talend Cloud (EU): https://app.eu.cloud.talend.com

Source: GitHub OMDS-BIDevOps/OMDG_BIBU. Fetched: 2026-06-01.

GLPI DATAFLOW ID: 262
GLPI DATAFLOW NAME: [FINANCEDATASTORE]-[HYPERION] Reports feed
FLOW GROUP: Integration Hub
FROM: SAP ERP EMEA
TO: Hyperion
GITHUB PATH: OMDG_BIBU/process/INTEGRATIONS_HUB/HYPERION_WIP/

TALEND JOBS:

1. SE_SAPERP_HYPERION_PLANNING_262
   Versions: 0.1, 0.2
   Purpose: Extracts planning data from SAP ERP EMEA and feeds Hyperion Planning module via FTP
   Status: WIP (Work In Progress)

2. SE_SL_PERIOD_HFM_PROCESSING_262
   Versions: 0.1, 1.0
   Purpose: Collects SAP GL data, transforms into 16-period HFM files, sends email notification, drops files on FTP server. Archives previous files with timestamp and cleans up files older than 1 month.
   Status: WIP (Work In Progress)

3. Weekly_SE_SAPERP_HYPERION_PLANNING_262
   Versions: 0.1
   Purpose: Weekly variant of the SAP ERP to Hyperion Planning job
   Status: WIP (Work In Progress)

NOTE: Folder is named HYPERION_WIP — all jobs are still in development/work-in-progress state.
